tasks.short: Maintain complete engineering department and machinery activity records.

steps.what: Establish actual engineering activities, interventions, exceptions and source completeness
inputs: actual engineering work and watch observations
actual machinery/alarm records
outputs: checked actual activity facts and selected source records

steps.what: Copy existing machinery activity and alarm fields into the separate engineering record workspace
inputs: checked actual activity facts and selected source records
actual existing machinery-system exports
outputs: staged engineering record fields with source/time provenance

steps.what: Write activity remarks from actual engineering observations and selected records
inputs: checked actual activity facts and selected source records
staged engineering record fields with source/time provenance
outputs: complete source-linked engineering record draft

loop.purpose: Draft descriptive activity remarks from engineer-checked facts
loop.input: actual activity notes and selected machinery records
loop.output: source-linked remarks with unresolved items left explicit
loop.check: Engineer checks actions, timing, omissions, operating-state meaning and whether any completion or cause was invented
loop.stop: Missing event facts, inconsistent time or two failed revisions returns remarks to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed log fields serve s2; variable activity explanations require semantic checking beyond field mapping

steps.what: Complete and check the whole engineering record against actual activity and original readings
inputs: complete source-linked engineering record draft
checked actual activity facts and selected source records
outputs: checked saved final engineering record snapshot

steps.what: Perform existing chief engineer review and authorise final record attestation
inputs: checked saved final engineering record snapshot
outputs: independently authorised final record snapshot for attestation

steps.what: Finalise the exact authorised official record attestation in the engineering log
inputs: independently authorised final record snapshot for attestation
outputs: actual finalised official engineering record

tasks.design: Test native machinery-to-log integration in engineering {OPS_SYSTEM}, bridging actual source fields only if needed; draft limited remarks from engineer-checked activity facts in {DOCS}. Retain complete record checks and the actual vessel's independent official-record review/attestation route, with ordinary internal saves ungated and final attestation earning no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing machinery fields are copied into another record workspace and remarks typed separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Electronic log integration can populate real instrument fields; constrained drafting can assist descriptive remarks.
tasks.still_hard: Completeness and operational meaning depend on actual watch activity.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes a real intervention from an alarm acknowledgement.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate log entry; watch accountability stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: NAPA Logbook supports entries filled from automation and sensor data.
Model knowledge: source-constrained drafting can assist descriptive engineering remarks but requires full operational checks.

assumptions: Provisional vessel route with existing independent chief-engineer review5, excluded from focal baseline95. Do not introduce that review if absent; map the actual accepted attestation route. s6 is official finalisation at1 point, not routine file saving. Routine saves in s4 are retained without self-gates.

Actual monitoring-system owner supplies timestamp/time zone, equipment id, event/value/unit, status and source version; engineer supplies fresh intervention/exception facts in s1. Missing events or unsupported feeds remain manual. Thirty-five points are actual second-workspace copying, not existing integration/runtime. Three of15 remark points are descriptive typing removed after retained review; no hidden capture or completion inference.
Actual vessel/flag acceptance, access and workforce consultation must be confirmed; no legal acceptance is inferred from a product feature.
unknowns: Which feeds are already integrated and what official attestation route actually applies?
research_questions: Can a shadow log reconcile every source timestamp and preserve actual engineer remarks?

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings, time synchronisation and source-linked remark checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact complete final engineering record snapshot reviewed in s5; any changed field or remark voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes35 second-workspace copy plus3 remark points:38/95*100 minus1.2=38.8. Low: legacy equipment leaves20 copying points manual and unusual interventions need fresh prose; only15 existing-feed copy points and2 descriptive remark points disappear, giving17/95*100 minus1.2=16.694. Actual facts, whole-record checks, chief review and1-point attestation retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record speed/direction orders and gauge or test readings in engineering logs.

steps.what: Verify actual speed/direction orders and observe readings not already held in monitoring records
inputs: actual engine telegraph orders and monitoring records
actual unconnected gauge or test observations
outputs: checked existing order/readout sources and actual manual readings

steps.what: Record orders for ship speed/direction and gauge readings from existing telegraph/monitoring exports
inputs: checked existing order/readout sources and actual manual readings
actual existing connected telegraph/monitoring export
outputs: staged source-linked order and instrument entries

steps.what: Write actual unconnected readings and contextual remarks in the engineering log or bellbook
inputs: staged source-linked order and instrument entries
checked existing order/readout sources and actual manual readings
outputs: complete log/bellbook draft including actual manual readings

steps.what: Check complete log entries against actual orders, timestamps, readings and remarks
inputs: complete log/bellbook draft including actual manual readings
checked existing order/readout sources and actual manual readings
outputs: checked saved final engineering log/bellbook snapshot

steps.what: Review final log/bellbook and authorise actual official finalisation under the existing vessel process
inputs: checked saved final engineering log/bellbook snapshot
outputs: independently authorised final log/bellbook snapshot

steps.what: Finalise the exact authorised official engineering log or bellbook snapshot
inputs: independently authorised final log/bellbook snapshot
outputs: actual finalised official log/bellbook

tasks.design: Test native telegraph/monitoring-to-log integration in engineering {OPS_SYSTEM} before a deterministic bridge. Copy only existing source orders/readings into staging, retaining actual manual observation and writing, complete checks and the actual vessel's independent official finalisation route; ordinary saves and official finalisation earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing connected readings and orders are re-keyed into a separate log module.
tasks.enabler_now: Timestamped source mappings can remove that actual second-module entry.
tasks.still_hard: Manual readings, clock mismatches and operational context require the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes an issued speed order from an actual machine response.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate log entry; operational responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: NAPA Logbook supports entries filled from automation and sensor data.

assumptions: Provisional route requires actual second-module re-key35; existing interfaces/runtime get zero credit. Existing chief-engineer review5 is other-role labour excluded from focal baseline95; do not invent it if the actual accepted vessel process differs.

Actual telegraph/monitoring owner supplies source timestamp/time zone, order type/direction, instrument id, value/unit and source status. Engineer verifies those records and observes unconnected gauges/tests in s1; writes the latter in s3. Missing feeds, unknown units or clocks mean manual entry. No new sensor, extraction or observation is supplied for free.

Ordinary internal saves are included unchanged and ungated in s4. s6 is actual official finalisation at1 point, not an inflated save, with no saving. Vessel acceptance/access and actual review/signature ownership need confirmation.
unknowns: Which readings/orders are actually connected and already imported?
research_questions: Can a shadow bellbook preserve order-versus-response distinctions and timestamp alignment?

incremental.description: Maintain connected-source mappings, clocks and missing-feed handling.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact complete log/bellbook snapshot reviewed in s5; any entry or remark change invalidates approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes35 actual source-to-log re-key points:35/95*100 minus1 upkeep=35.842. Low: most gauges remain unconnected or clocks need manual reconciliation; only10 existing telegraph-entry points disappear, giving10/95*100 minus1=9.526. Actual observation, manual readings/remarks, full checks, chief review and1-point finalisation retain their time.

tasks.short: Order, receive and track engine-room stores and usage.

steps.what: Check actual engine-room stock, needs and order quantities for oil or spare parts
inputs: actual stores and inventory records
actual machinery maintenance and operating needs
outputs: actual checked stock and chosen stores requirement

steps.what: Prepare and check actual stores order, supplier, quantities, terms and delivery destination
inputs: actual checked stock and chosen stores requirement
actual current supplier quote and part specifications
outputs: checked final stores order version and supplier destination

steps.what: Review final stores order and authorise actual supplier commitment under existing budget authority
inputs: checked final stores order version and supplier destination
outputs: independently authorised final stores order and supplier destination

steps.what: Send the exact authorised stores order to the specified supplier
inputs: independently authorised final stores order and supplier destination
outputs: actual supplier order and acknowledgement

steps.what: Receive actual oil or spare parts and verify quantity, identity and condition
inputs: actual supplier order and acknowledgement
actual delivered stores
outputs: actual checked stores receipt and discrepancies

steps.what: Observe and measure actual oil or spare-part consumption and remaining stock
inputs: actual checked stores receipt and discrepancies
actual subsequent stores use and stock
outputs: actual usage quantities and stock observations

steps.what: Maintain inventories and record actual stores receipts, discrepancies and supply usage
inputs: actual checked stores receipt and discrepancies
actual usage quantities and stock observations
outputs: checked saved actual stores inventory and usage record

tasks.design: Configure reuse of actual supplier/part/order fields in {PROCUREMENT}. Retain specification and budget checks, the existing independent chief-engineer order review, explicit supplier send, physical receipt/use observation and complete inventory/usage writing in {OPS_SYSTEM}; ordinary saves and send earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stores order fields may be repeatedly assembled around actual purchasing choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native order-field reuse can reduce entry without choosing supplies or authorising spend.
tasks.still_hard: Part suitability, delivery condition and real consumption require the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer rejects a nominally matching part unsuitable for the machinery.
tasks.altitude: Less stores-order preparation; receiving and inventory accountability stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native order-field reuse can reduce stores preparation while physical receiving and usage records require actual observations.

assumptions: Provisional route with existing chief-engineer budget review5 excluded from focal baseline95; no new approver. Five of20 order points are repeated supplier/part field assembly, fifteen actual choice/check points remain. Existing native reuse gets zero credit.

Actual supplier provides dated quote, part specification, quantity/unit, currency and destination terms; engineer checks needs/compatibility in s1/s2. Actual receipt and usage are observed in s5/s6 before new record writing s7; no consumption inferred from order or delivery. Missing information requires manual verification. Ordinary inventory saves are included unchanged in s7, without self-gate or saving; no free transferred crew labour.
unknowns: How much native order reuse exists and who holds actual budget review?
research_questions: Can order reuse preserve machinery part revision, quantity units and vessel delivery details?

incremental.description: Maintain stores order field applicability and supplier/part revisions.

approvals.approved_version: s2 exact final stores order, quantities, terms and named supplier destination reviewed in s3; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 repeated order-preparation points:5/95*100 minus0.8=4.463. Low: an unusual spare needs fresh sourcing and specification checks, leaving only2 existing supplier/vessel-field points reusable, giving2/95*100 minus0.8=1.305. Budget review, actual send, receipt, usage observations and complete inventory records retain their time.

tasks.short: Liaise between captain and shore personnel on schedules, budgets and safe operations.

steps.what: Locate and check actual vessel schedule, engineering constraints and budget status
inputs: actual captain/shore coordination issue
actual current vessel schedule, engineering and posted budget records
outputs: checked current coordination status and unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Liaise with captain and shore personnel on actual schedule, budget and safe-operation choices
inputs: checked current coordination status and unresolved discrepancies
actual captain and shore constraints and responses
outputs: actual coordination decisions, unresolved risks and assignments

steps.what: Write and check assigned actual coordination decisions and follow-up records
inputs: actual coordination decisions, unresolved risks and assignments
outputs: checked saved actual liaison follow-up record

tasks.design: Configure native current-status views and links in vessel {OPS_SYSTEM}, {ERP} and {PROJECT}, without inventing a new cross-system feed. Reduce repeat status navigation while retaining source checks, actual captain/shore coordination and complete assigned written follow-up; ordinary internal save stays unchanged and ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current schedule, engineering and budget status can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views and current-source links can reduce locating work.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting schedule, cost and safe-operation constraints require accountable coordination.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer explains why an operational constraint cannot be traded for a deadline.
tasks.altitude: Less status navigation; captain and shore decision rights stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native status views can reduce liaison preparation navigation while vessel coordination remains human.

assumptions: Provisional status20 includes five repeated locating/filtering points; fifteen factual checks remain. Existing views and source-system runtime earn no new credit. No unrepresented machine report, alert or data feed is named in the design.

Actual scheduler supplies dated vessel schedule; engineering owners supply actual constraints; finance supplies posted cost/budget period, currency and status. Missing or contradictory data requires manual owner confirmation. No future completion or safe operation inferred from schedule. Assigned actual written follow-up is separate and retained; no extra email send or new captain/shore labour is invented.
unknowns: Which current status views and actual liaison records already exist?
research_questions: Can filtered views preserve the distinction between posted costs and forecast commitments?

incremental.description: Maintain current vessel/status filters and source links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 repeat status-navigation points minus0.6 upkeep=4.4. Low: a disrupted voyage needs new manual schedule and budget clarification, leaving only1 stable engineering-status locating point removed, minus0.6=0.4. Actual checks, liaison discussion and full written follow-up retain their time.
